steps: Assess wear - light wear may only need a screen-and-recoat, not full sanding.
Clear the room fully and remove baseboards if doing edge sanding.
A drum/orbital sander removes the old finish in progressive grits (36 to 100+).
Vacuum thoroughly and apply stain (if changing color) followed by 2-3 coats of finish.
For most homeowners, hiring a pro is recommended - sanding mistakes gouge the wood permanently.
